events.title: Devlog: Iron Void Doubles in Size – 120 Missions & 10 Bosses
events.summary: Hi pilots! Steam Next Fest has been amazing, and your feedback pushed us to do something big before launch: we doubled the campaign. Here is a look behind the scenes.120 missions in 10 actsThe campaign grows from 60 to 120 hand-built missions, now organized into ten acts. The story continues after Void Requiem: the silence was never the end – the signal is coming from deeper in the void.Act VI – Afterglow: bomber and turret sieges in the ashes of the last war.Act VII – Hollow Reach: spark swarms

events.title: Demo Update: Punchier Combat, New Camera & Clearer HUD
events.summary: Thank you again for all the feedback from Steam Next Fest! Here is what's new in the Iron Void demo:Combat feelMuzzle flashes on every gun – yours and your enemies' – so you always see who is firing.Missile smoke trails and launch puffs.Stronger screen shake when you fire, launch missiles, boost and when ships explode near you.Camera & settingsThe camera now sits further back so you can read the fight, with a wider default field of view.New Screen Shake and Camera Distance sliders in the setting

events.title: Demo Update: 12 Missions, First Boss & Evasive Roll
events.summary: Thank you for all the feedback during Steam Next Fest! Here's what's new in the demo:More to playThe demo now includes 12 missions – all the way to the first boss, Ironclad.New: Evasive RollHold L2 (or E on keyboard) to barrel-roll out of danger. While you spin, incoming fire can't touch you – but it drains your energy just like boost.Controller layoutDrift moved to R1 so you can drift without letting go of the aim stick.Ability is now on Triangle / Y, missiles on D-pad Up.FixesThe game now star

events.title: LIVE: Iron Void Demo Gameplay – Steam Next Fest
events.summary: Tune in any time — we're streaming Iron Void: Silent Space demo gameplay around the clock until the end of Steam Next Fest. No commentary, just the silent void.What you'll seeThird-person dogfights against weaving, swarming enemy fightersBullet-hell barrages, a heat-managed cannon and lock-on missilesMissions straight from the demoPlay it yourselfThe demo is playable right now. If you enjoy it, please add Iron Void: Silent Space to your wishlist — it really helps our small indie team!
